summary: Iteration 9: Verified new social layer end-to-end — home feed timeline, saves + collections, threaded comment replies, @mentions with notifications, artwork shares (with throttled notification), post likes/comments, followers/following lists, and enriched notifications. Backend: 19/19 pytest passed against preview URL (isolated buyer+artist fixtures, forced artwork to live via pymongo). Frontend (Desktop 1920px + Mobile 375px): /feed shows PostCard + ArtworkFeedCard with optimistic Heart/Comment/Share/Save toggles; /saved renders SavedIndex with New Collection modal that successfully creates a collection; All Saved pseudo-collection opens CollectionDetail and shows the auto-saved artwork tile; ArtworkDetail has working save-btn / share-btn / reply-btn with inline reply-input and nested reply-{id} rendering; @UIArtistName rendered in #CCFF00 accent inside the comment body; Notifications page correctly renders 5 new social kinds with proper labels (Mentioned you, New comment on your artwork, Liked your post, Your artwork was shared, New follower). nav-feed and nav-saved appear only when logged in. No horizontal overflow at 375px. Only console noise is image 404s from placeholder /uploads/x.jpg used in seeded data — not a real bug.

issues: Notification subtitle concatenates artwork title and user name without separator, e.g. 'TESTArt 3b56ef81UIBuyer3b56ef81'. Add a space or dash between artwork.title and other.name in Notifications.js templates.

action_items: Fix concatenation bug in Notifications.js for new social kinds (artwork title + other.name run together — needs a separator).
Consider adding an `artist` link/href resolution for @mentions so clicking a mention navigates to /artist/{id} — currently only styled, not clickable.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate post-like route: /api/posts/{id}/like is defined in BOTH social.py (via /api prefix) and studio.py's posts_router (/api/posts prefix). Only the first one registered wins (social's), which is fortunate because it also fires the post_liked notification, but the studio-router version is dead code and confusing — remove it from studio.py.

social.py home_feed queries studio_posts + artworks with a fixed limit of `limit` each then merges and re-truncates; this ignores pagination and can miss older artworks if a followed artist has many posts. Consider proper cursor-based pagination.
collections/mine performs N+1 queries: for each collection loads 3 covers then a per-cover artworks lookup. For heavy users this is O(N*3) queries. Use $lookup aggregation.
Home feed's `renderText` in HomeFeed.js styles @mentions but they are not clickable/linkified — poor UX.
ArtworkDetail.js `share()` toasts 'Link copied' only in the non-native branch; if navigator.share exists it silently completes with no visual feedback.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (home feed, saves + collections modal, artwork replies, mentions, shares, notifications, mobile viewport all verified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; use `-n 0` when running test_social_feed.py because module-scoped fixtures share buyer/artist across classes. Duplicate /posts/{id}/like route exists between social.py and studio.py — the social one wins because it's registered first. Artwork requires width_in/height_in fields in POST /api/artworks (they were missing from prior test setup docs).
